coverage: Captured every exposed Page Types / Screen Types, Flows, UX Patterns, UI Elements and Categories list for web and iOS, plus the web-only Fonts list. The web and iOS directories independently exposed the same 40 and 35 category labels as their search selectors. Latest is a sorting control and New is a badge, so neither is a taxonomy term. The account exposed filter vocabulary while limiting screen results; no upgrade, auth, pricing or MCP settings were changed. Styles taxonomy belongs to the separate styles snapshot. Original spelling, ordering, platform differences and subgroup text are preserved. Identical font names are represented once; sourceIds preserve Refero’s distinct original rows for repeated names (123 font rows, 117 names).
